title: Engine response to operation: signatures (/io/response.json)
description: The public signatures of the candidate in each file of changed_files: name, signature as written in the language, first part of the docstring and lines. No bodies: the Saboteur (§3) writes tests against the interface and the contract, never against the implementation; if it saw the code, its tests would confirm what the builder did instead of refuting it. With a non-null error, the core proceeds without signatures and says so in the artifact.

name.description: Qualified name within the file (f, Class, Class.method).

signature.description: The header as the language would write it: def f(x: int) -> str, export function g(a: A): B.

doc.description: Docstring or documentation comment, trimmed; null if there is none.

lines.description: [first, last] of the symbol in the candidate, to cross with the uncovered lines.
